reasoning_content:
The environment looks as described. Apache is running. Let me verify the following:
1. Whether the extracted file structure matches the zip manifest (201 entries)
2. Whether HTTP requests to the portal URL work
3. Whether the main files (index.html, config.js, config.json, resources, mastercode) exist and are valid

Let's check the file count, compare it against the zip's contents, and then curl the portal.

action.command: cd /var/www/html/examples && unzip -l /workspace/examples.zip | awk 'NR>3 {print $4}' | grep -v '^$' | grep -v '^Name$' | sort > /tmp/zip_entries.txt; find . -mindepth 1 | sed 's|^\./||' | sort > /tmp/fs_entries.txt; wc -l /tmp/zip_entries.txt /tmp/fs_entries.txt; echo "=== diff (zip vs fs) ==="; diff /tmp/zip_entries.txt /tmp/fs_entries.txt && echo "IDENTICAL (excluding the Basic symlink)"
